# Hardwired-pause coverage matrix (generated by `closure pause coverage --write`; do not edit by hand)

Source: "The Feasibility of a Hardwired Pause of Frontier AI Training", Working Group on AI Pause Feasibility, working paper v1.0.1, 10 October 2026. Status vocabulary: implemented (code and tests here), hardware-gated (code here, needs real hardware or design data), external (another repo on the account), partial, not-started, physical and policy (outside software scope).

**75 items.** Software-addressable: 58, of which 58 have code or a repository behind them. implemented 40, hardware-gated 7, external 0, partial 11, not-started 0, physical 3, policy 14.

A pause is mostly institutions, inspections and politics. Those items are marked as such and are not counted as covered; the code here makes the paper's quantitative claims checkable and its accounting executable.

Paths that start with `external/` are in the repositories vendored under external/ (pinned by external/MANIFEST.json); `closure external test` runs their own test suites.
